# Week 0: Asynchronous Onboarding {.unnumbered}

## Purpose

Students complete the basic account and orientation work before the first class so Week 1 can focus on health data, ethics, and course expectations.

## Required Student Tasks

- Create a GitHub account using a professional username.
- Watch the course workflow orientation video posted on Canvas.
- Complete the pre-course survey.
- Confirm access to Canvas and the course GitHub entry point.
